requests.description: Inspect the latest 45 days of point-in-time price and volume to establish the pre-prediction trend, baseline level, and any early repricing, used only as orientation for the fixed 2x Predictor.
Read the most recent applicable operating report available before the prediction time for the business model, risk factors, segment economics, and any disclosed non-recurring items.
Retrieve the most recent management commentary or earnings-call transcript available before the prediction time, for forward expectations, demand commentary, and guidance cadence.
Retrieve recent third-party news mentioning the target issuer, covering commercial adoption, contracts, financing, listing events, and regulatory developments that could shift market expectations.

Inspect reported financial facts available at the prediction time for revenue growth, margins, cash runway, and capital structure; treat computed runway metrics as descriptive, not as forward projections.

initial_native_output.H_analyse: Organize evidence into (a) source-backed commercial adoption and contract or demand evidence, (b) forward-expectations and guidance signals, (c) financing, share-overhang, cash-runway, and dilution facts, (d) market baseline, momentum, and early-repricing measurements, and (e) counter-evidence and execution gaps. Weight items by provenance and recency, prefer issuer filings and reported financial facts over third-party narrative, and never count repeated versions of one event as independent evidence. When binary direction looks supported, structure a range of plausible repricing scenarios rather than defaulting to a conservative band, and do not let a negative liquidity-runway or neutral financing fact mechanically cap the scenario range. Surface explicit counter-evidence and uncertainty; do not compute a probability, classify the final answer, or generate the prediction.
initial_native_output.H_init: From Basic Info only, state a commercialization and expectation-gap hypothesis for the fixed six-calendar-month adjusted-share-price 2x Predictor: is there source-backed evidence of real commercial adoption or a catalyst, or only narrative? List the most decision-relevant unresolved information needs, separating business-model questions, demand/contract evidence, financing and share-overhang facts, and market-repricing evidence. Explicitly flag low-baseline issuers with binary catalysts, deeply depressed prior drawdowns, and any source types unavailable for technical reasons (quota or validation failures), treating those as execution gaps rather than as evidence that the data is absent. Do not name or define magnitude classes, do not assign probabilities, and do not finalize a prediction here.
initial_native_output.H_reflect: After each evidence pass, update support, contradiction, resolved questions, and remaining gaps against the fixed 2x Predictor. Weigh whether source-backed commercial adoption, guidance, and early repricing are real versus narrative, and whether counter-evidence (share overhang, weak cash runway, dilution risk, negative momentum) should bear more on direction or specifically on magnitude, without deciding which direction or magnitude is likely. Choose continue only if a named, answerable information need remains that could flip the thesis; otherwise finalize evidence collection. Never decide the price direction, market trend, or outcome; leave the final four-way judgment and magnitude classification to the fixed Predictor shell.

operations.value: After each evidence pass, update ResearchState only: what the collected evidence supports, what it contradicts, which questions are resolved, and which named, answerable information needs remain against the fixed six-calendar-month adjusted-share-price 2x Predictor. Weigh whether source-backed commercial adoption, guidance, and early repricing evidence are corroborated versus narrative, and whether counter-evidence such as share overhang, weak cash runway, dilution risk, or negative momentum is source-backed or merely asserted, so later evidence collection can prioritize the weakest, most decision-relevant gap. Do not state, estimate, rank, or hint at which price direction, market trend, outcome, or magnitude class is likely, and do not name, define, or finalize any replacement Predictor class ontology; the fixed Predictor shell owns the final candidate_judgment and magnitude classification. Choose continue only if a specific, answerable information need remains that could materially change the evidence picture; otherwise finalize evidence collection and hand the organized evidence to the fixed Predictor shell.

initial_native_output.H_analyse: Organize and weight supporting and counter evidence for the fixed six-calendar-month 2x Predictor. Distinguish real commercial adoption and binding commitments from narrative and promotional coverage. For magnitude structuring, map source-backed catalysts to a range of possible repricing multiples rather than collapsing to a single conservative band, while explicitly retaining limitations: realized multiples are horizon maxima, backward-looking momentum does not project the six-month horizon, and single-case outcomes do not establish ex-ante calibration. Expose uncertainty and counter-evidence (resale overhang, low cash, dilution risk) as factors that may bear more on magnitude than on binary direction, but flag that relationship as an untested hypothesis rather than an established rule. Do not compute probabilities, classify the final answer, alter the horizon or four-way judgment, or generate the prediction.
initial_native_output.H_init: Form an initial commercialization and expectation-gap hypothesis for the fixed six-calendar-month 2x adjusted-price Predictor using Basic Info only. Explicitly separate: (a) binary direction evidence for whether the target issuer is positioned for a potential surge, and (b) magnitude-scenario evidence that could support a wider or narrower band. Do NOT default to a conservative magnitude band when the binary direction is supported; instead enumerate a range of plausible repricing multiples and note which specific source-backed facts (commercial adoption, binding contracts, early repricing) would justify the upper end versus the lower end. State the most decision-relevant unresolved information needs, including any gap in management commentary, forward guidance, or off-take/customer commitments that would materially narrow the magnitude range. Do not name or define replacement Predictor classes; the fixed shell owns final candidate_judgment and conditional magnitude classification.
initial_native_output.H_reflect: Reflect over the full Signal batch. Track source-backed support and counter-evidence for the binary thesis, and separately track magnitude-related evidence (commercial adoption, contract durability, liquidity/dilution framing, momentum-implied ranges). Test whether any negative liquidity-runway or neutral financing signal is being used to cap the magnitude band rather than to inform the binary call, and record that as an explicit hypothesis with its limitations. When deciding whether to continue or finalize evidence collection, apply a falsification test: identify what observable catalyst or price action would invalidate the current binary view within the horizon. Decide only whether evidence collection should continue or finalize; do not decide which price direction or magnitude class is likely.

operations.value: Reflect over the full Signal batch as a collection-continuation decision only. Track source-backed support and counter-evidence for the binary thesis, and separately track magnitude-related evidence (commercial adoption, contract durability, liquidity/dilution framing, momentum-implied ranges). Test whether any negative liquidity-runway or neutral financing signal is being used to cap the magnitude band rather than to inform the binary call, and record that as an explicit hypothesis with its limitations. When deciding whether to continue or finalize evidence collection, apply a coverage-and-falsifiability test: check whether the current source set still leaves material information needs unresolved (management commentary, forward guidance, off-take or customer commitments) and whether an explicit falsification condition for the working thesis is on record. Record resolved questions, remaining needs, and any unresolved gaps. Decide only whether evidence collection should continue or finalize, and which next source requests are needed; do not decide, name, or estimate which price direction, market trend, or magnitude class is likely.
